source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Keeps slave language and the named brother; the note preserves kept by as an alternative to kept for.
verses.before: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to people who are called, beloved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ:
verses.after: Jude, a slave of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to those who are called, beloved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ:
verses.tsw_comparator: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to those who are called, beloved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ:

verses.rationale: Retains all three gifts and the multiplication image.
verses.before: May mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you.
verses.after: May mercy, peace and love be multiplied to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: May mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you.

verses.rationale: Preserves the change in writing purpose, struggle language and once-for-all entrusting.
verses.before: Beloved, although I was making every effort to write to you about our shared salvation, I found it necessary to write appealing to you to contend for the faith that was once for all delivered to the saints.
verses.after: Beloved, although I was eager to write to you about the salvation we share, I found it necessary to write urging you to contend for the faith entrusted once for all to the holy ones.
verses.tsw_comparator: Beloved, although I was making every effort to write to you about our shared salvation, I found it necessary to write appealing to you to contend for the faith that was once for all delivered to the saints.

verses.rationale: Keeps the covert entry and judgment claim; the note explains the broader shameless-excess range of recklessness.
verses.before: For certain people have slipped in unnoticed, those long beforehand marked out for this judgment, ungodly persons who turn the grace of our God into sensuality and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
verses.after: For certain people have slipped in unnoticed, people long ago marked out for this judgment: ungodly people who turn our God's grace into sexual recklessness and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: For certain people have slipped in unnoticed, those long beforehand marked out for this judgment, ungodly persons who turn the grace of our God into sensuality and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Follows the consequential pinned Jesus reading and preserves both deliverance and destruction.
verses.before: Now I want to remind you, although you once knew everything, that Jesus, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed people who did not believe.
verses.after: I want to remind you, though you have learned all this once for all, that Jesus saved a people out of Egypt and afterward destroyed those who did not believe.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now I want to remind you, although you once knew all things, that Jesus, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.

verses.rationale: Retains the keep/kept contrast, abandoned dwelling and eternal chains without adding identities.
verses.before: And the angels who did not keep their own domain but left their proper dwelling, he has kept in eternal chains under darkness for the judgment of the great day,
verses.after: And the angels who did not keep their own position of authority but abandoned their proper dwelling, he has kept in eternal chains under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
verses.tsw_comparator: And the angels who did not keep their own domain but left their proper dwelling, he has kept in eternal chains under darkness for the judgment of the great day,

verses.rationale: Preserves other flesh and the comparison's uncertain referent rather than assigning modern categories.
verses.before: just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding cities, which likewise indulged in sexual immorality and pursued unnatural desire, serve as an example by undergoing a punishment of eternal fire.
verses.after: Likewise, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding cities, which in the same way as these indulged in sexual immorality and pursued other flesh, stand as an example, undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.
verses.tsw_comparator: just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding cities, which likewise indulged in sexual immorality and pursued unnatural desire, serve as an example by undergoing a punishment of eternal fire.

verses.rationale: Keeps the three acts and the unspecified lordship and glorious beings.
verses.before: Yet in the same way these people also, relying on their dreams, defile the flesh, reject authority, and slander glorious ones.
verses.after: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile the flesh, reject lordship and revile glorious beings.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yet in the same way these people also, relying on their dreams, defile the flesh, reject authority, and slander glorious ones.

verses.rationale: Retains the named dispute and restraint without importing the larger traditional story.
verses.before: But when the archangel Michael, contending with the devil, was disputing about the body of Moses, he did not presume to pronounce a reviling judgment, but said, “The Lord rebuke you.”
verses.after: But when Michael the archangel disputed with the devil about Moses' body, he did not dare bring a reviling judgment against him, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
verses.tsw_comparator: But when the archangel Michael, contending with the devil, was disputing about the body of Moses, he did not presume to pronounce a reviling judgment, but said, “The Lord rebuke you.”

verses.rationale: Preserves the contrast between uncomprehending insult and destructive instinct.
verses.before: But these people blaspheme all that they do not understand, and they are destroyed by all that they, like unreasoning animals, understand instinctively.
verses.after: These people revile whatever they do not understand, and what they do understand by instinct, like unreasoning animals, destroys them.
verses.tsw_comparator: But these people blaspheme all that they do not understand, and they are destroyed by all that they, like unreasoning animals, understand instinctively.

verses.rationale: Keeps all three named examples and the source's forceful completed-action rhetoric.
verses.before: Woe to them! For they walked in the way of Cain and abandoned themselves for the sake of gain to Balaam’s error and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
verses.after: Woe to them! They have gone the way of Cain, rushed into Balaam's error for pay and perished in Korah's rebellion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Woe to them! For they walked in the way of Cain and abandoned themselves for the sake of gain to Balaam’s error and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

verses.rationale: Preserves the sequence of images and twice dead; the note records the alternative blemishes for reefs.
verses.before: These are hidden reefs at your love feasts, as they feast with you without fear, shepherds feeding themselves; waterless clouds, carried along by winds; fruitless trees in late autumn, twice dead, uprooted;
verses.after: These people are hidden reefs at your love feasts, feasting with you without fear, shepherding themselves. They are clouds without water, swept along by winds; late-autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, uprooted;
verses.tsw_comparator: These are hidden reefs at your love feasts, as they feast with you without fear, shepherds feeding themselves; waterless clouds, carried along by winds; fruitless trees in late autumn, twice dead, uprooted;

verses.rationale: Keeps the sea and sky images, shame and lasting judgment.
verses.before: wild waves of the sea, casting up the foam of their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the gloom of utter darkness has been reserved forever.
verses.after: wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars for whom the deepest darkness has been reserved forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: wild waves of the sea, casting up the foam of their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the gloom of utter darkness has been reserved forever.

verses.rationale: Retains the genealogical ordinal, named prophetic attribution and quotation's past-tense came.
verses.before: It was also about these that Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord comes with ten thousands of his holy ones,
verses.after: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about these people: “Look, the Lord came with myriads of his holy ones,
verses.tsw_comparator: It was also about these that Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord comes with ten thousands of his holy ones,

verses.rationale: Preserves the deliberate fourfold ungodly repetition and the scope of judgment.
verses.before: to execute judgment on all and to convict all the ungodly of all their deeds of ungodliness that they have committed in such an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things that ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
verses.after: to bring judgment against everyone and convict all the ungodly of all their ungodly deeds they have done in ungodliness, and of all the harsh things ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
verses.tsw_comparator: to execute judgment on all and to convict all the ungodly of all their deeds of ungodliness that they have committed in such an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things that ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”

verses.rationale: Renders admiration of faces as flattery while preserving self-interest and speech imagery.
verses.before: These are grumblers, malcontents, following their own desires; they are loud-mouthed, showing favoritism to gain advantage.
verses.after: These people are grumblers and faultfinders, following their own desires. Their mouths speak boastfully, and they flatter people for their own advantage.
verses.tsw_comparator: These are grumblers, malcontents, following their own desires; they are loud-mouthed, showing favoritism to gain advantage.

verses.rationale: Keeps the contrastive address and prior apostolic words.
verses.before: But you must remember, beloved, the predictions of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.after: But you, beloved, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you must remember, beloved, the predictions of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Preserves the quotation's timing and ungodly-desire vocabulary.
verses.before: They said to you, “In the last time there will be scoffers, following their own ungodly desires.”
verses.after: They told you, “In the last time there will be scoffers who follow their own ungodly desires.”
verses.tsw_comparator: They said to you, “In the last time there will be scoffers, following their own ungodly desires.”

verses.rationale: Renders psychikoi with its natural-life sense and preserves the explicit absence of the Spirit.
verses.before: It is these who cause divisions, worldly people, devoid of the Spirit.
verses.after: These are the people who cause divisions, governed by natural life, without the Spirit.
verses.tsw_comparator: It is these who cause divisions, worldly people, devoid of the Spirit.

verses.rationale: Keeps the building image and the coordinated instruction across verses.
verses.before: But you, beloved, building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
verses.after: But you, beloved, build yourselves up in your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
verses.tsw_comparator: But you, beloved, building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,

verses.rationale: Preserves keeping and waiting, with mercy's orientation toward eternal life.
verses.before: keep yourselves in the love of God, waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to eternal life.
verses.after: and keep yourselves in God's love, waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to eternal life.
verses.tsw_comparator: keep yourselves in the love of God, waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to eternal life.

verses.rationale: Follows the pinned mercy-to-doubters reading and retains its distinct group.
verses.before: And have mercy on people who doubt;
verses.after: Have mercy on those who doubt;
verses.tsw_comparator: And have mercy on those who doubt;

verses.rationale: Preserves the three-part sequence across verses, rescue image and strong garment/flesh language.
verses.before: save others by snatching them out of the fire; to others show mercy with fear, hating even the garment stained by the flesh.
verses.after: save others by snatching them from the fire; and have mercy on others with fear, hating even the garment stained by the flesh.
verses.tsw_comparator: save others by snatching them out of the fire; to others show mercy with fear, hating even the garment stained by the flesh.

verses.rationale: Keeps the keeping and standing images and joyful presentation.
verses.before: Now to the one who can keep you from stumbling and to present you blameless before the presence of his glory with great joy,
verses.after: To the one who can keep you from stumbling and make you stand blameless before his glory with great joy,
verses.tsw_comparator: Now to the one who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you blameless before the presence of his glory with great joy,

verses.rationale: Follows the full pinned doxology including through Jesus Christ and before all time.
verses.before: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority, before all time and now and forever. Amen.
verses.after: to the only God, our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, power and authority, before all time, now and for all ages. Amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority, before all time and now and forever. Amen.
